questions.grammar_rule: Zero Conditional: If + Present Simple, Present Simple (for facts/truths)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Zero Conditional: If + Present Simple, Present Simple (faktlar uchun)
questions.explanation: Zero Conditional states scientific facts: If you do X, Y happens (always)

questions.sentence: If it ___, we will stay home.
questions.grammar_rule: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + base verb
questions.grammar_rule_uz: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + fe'l
questions.explanation: First Conditional uses Present Simple after 'if' for real future possibilities

questions.sentence: If you study hard, you ___ pass the exam.
questions.grammar_rule: First Conditional: will + verb for certain results
questions.grammar_rule_uz: First Conditional: aniq natija uchun will + fe'l
questions.explanation: First Conditional uses 'will' for a certain/likely result

questions.sentence: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.grammar_rule: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple (were for all subjects), would + base verb
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple (barcha shaxslar uchun 'were'), would + fe'l
questions.explanation: Second Conditional uses 'were' for all subjects in formal English

questions.sentence: Which sentence is a Zero Conditional?
questions.correct_answer: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
options: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
If you study, you will pass.
If I were you, I would study.
If I had studied, I would have passed.
questions.grammar_rule: Zero Conditional expresses general truths and scientific facts
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Zero Conditional umumiy haqiqatlar va ilmiy faktlarni ifodalaydi
questions.explanation: Zero Conditional: Present + Present for facts that are always true

questions.sentence: If I will have time, I will call you.
questions.correct_answer: If I have time, I will call you.
questions.grammar_rule: Don't use 'will' in the 'if' clause of First Conditional
questions.grammar_rule_uz: First Conditional 'if' qismida 'will' ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: After 'if' in First Conditional, use Present Simple, not 'will'

questions.sentence: If she had known, she ___ come.
questions.grammar_rule: Third Conditional: If + Past Perfect, would have + past participle
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Third Conditional: If + Past Perfect, would have + past participle
questions.explanation: Third Conditional talks about unreal past situations

questions.original_sentence: I don't have a car, so I can't drive you.
questions.correct_answer: If I had a car, I would/could drive you.
questions.grammar_rule: Second Conditional for unreal present situations
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Second Conditional hozirgi nohaqiqiy vaziyatlar uchun
questions.explanation: Transform real present to imaginary: If I had X, I would Y

questions.sentence: If I ___ you, I would apologize.
questions.grammar_rule: 'If I were you' is a fixed expression for giving advice
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'If I were you' maslahat berish uchun qo'llaniladigan ibora
questions.explanation: 'If I were you' uses 'were' (not 'was') in formal/standard English

questions.sentence: If I had taken the earlier bus, I ___ late.
questions.grammar_rule: Third Conditional negative: would not have + past participle
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Third Conditional inkor: would not have + past participle
questions.explanation: Third Conditional uses 'would have + past participle' for unreal past

questions.sentence: If I would have known, I would have helped.
questions.correct_answer: If I had known, I would have helped.
questions.grammar_rule: Third Conditional 'if' clause uses Past Perfect, not 'would have'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Third Conditional 'if' qismida Past Perfect ishlatiladi, 'would have' emas
questions.explanation: In the 'if' clause of Third Conditional, use 'had + past participle'

questions.sentence: If she ___ harder last year, she would have better grades now.
questions.grammar_rule: Mixed Conditional: Past condition affects present result
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Aralash shart gap: O'tmishdagi shart hozirgi natijaga ta'sir qiladi
questions.explanation: Mixed Conditional: If + Past Perfect (past), would + base verb (present result)

questions.original_sentence: I didn't know, so I didn't tell you.
questions.correct_answer: If I had known, I would have told you.
questions.grammar_rule: Third Conditional for unreal past situations
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Third Conditional o'tmishdagi nohaqiqiy vaziyatlar uchun
questions.explanation: Transform past reality to imaginary past: If I had X, I would have Y

questions.sentence: If she were more careful, she ___ the mistake yesterday.
questions.grammar_rule: Mixed Conditional: Present unreal condition, past result
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Aralash shart gap: Hozirgi nohaqiqiy shart, o'tmishdagi natija
questions.explanation: If + Past Simple (present unreal), would have + past participle (past result)

questions.sentence: ___ I known earlier, I would have acted differently.
questions.grammar_rule: Inversion in conditionals: Had + subject replaces 'If + subject + had'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Shart gaplarda inversiya: 'If + ega + had' o'rniga 'Had + ega'
questions.explanation: Formal inversion: 'Had I known' = 'If I had known'

questions.sentence: If I was you, I would take the job.
questions.correct_answer: If I were you, I would take the job.
questions.grammar_rule: Use 'were' (subjunctive) with all subjects in formal Second Conditional
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Rasmiy Second Conditional da barcha shaxslar bilan 'were' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: In formal English, 'were' is used for all persons in Second Conditional

questions.sentence: ___ you need any help, just let me know.
questions.grammar_rule: Inversion with 'should' for unlikely First Conditional
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'Should' bilan inversiya kam ehtimollik uchun
questions.explanation: 'Should you' = 'If you should' for formal or unlikely conditions

questions.original_sentence: If it were not for his help, I would fail.
questions.correct_answer: Were it not for his help, I would fail.
questions.grammar_rule: Conditional inversion: Were + subject replaces 'If + subject + were'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Shart gap inversiyasi: 'If + ega + were' o'rniga 'Were + ega'
questions.explanation: Formal inversion: 'Were it not for' = 'If it were not for'

questions.sentence: If only I ___ listen to your advice.
questions.grammar_rule: 'If only' + Past Perfect expresses regret about the past
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'If only' + Past Perfect o'tmish haqida afsuslanishni ifodalaydi
questions.explanation: 'If only' + Past Perfect (had + past participle) for past regrets

questions.correct_answer: If I had saved money, I would be rich now.
options: If I had saved money, I would be rich now.
If I saved money, I will be rich.
If I save money, I would be rich.
If I had saved, I would have been rich.
questions.grammar_rule: Mixed Conditional: Past condition (had + past participle) + present result (would + base verb)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Aralash shart gap: O'tgan shart + hozirgi natija
questions.explanation: Mixed: Past action affects present state = If + Past Perfect, would + base verb
